env.description: The LDO_* environment both functions receive (what the runtime reads).

manifest.description: Every slot S01-S16: {part, built, name, arn}. S08's arn is the event source mapping's UUID; S12's is the grant id.

sender_policy_arn.description: Attach to any principal that must put events in this LDO's mailbox.

account_id.description: The account every fence pattern names.

fence_exemption_arns.description: Every firm bucket: the principal ARNs infra/logic/registry/exemptions.json exempts from its fence.

fence_patterns.description: Every firm: long form -> the IAM ARN globs matching principals that carry its scope token (fence_patterns()).

fence_scoped_statements.description: Every firm bucket: the Deny statements that cut each scoped exemption row (actions + prefix) down to those actions under that prefix; an empty list for a bucket with no scoped row.

name.description: lib/opal_naming.py name() over the inputs; null when no name is asked for.

scope_bucket.description: Every scope: long form -> its bucket.

scope_class.description: Every scope: long form -> its class.

scope_long.description: Every spelling lookup() resolves (long, short, alias) -> the long form.

scope_short.description: Every scope: long form -> short form.

fifo.description: true appends the AWS-required .fifo suffix after an SQS_QUEUE kind (queue or dlq); NAMING_SCHEMA.json resource.fifo.

function.description: The function words, lowercase kebab-case ASCII.

kind.description: A NAMING_SCHEMA.json kind.values member, or a cadence for an EVENT_RULE or SCHEDULE.

qualifier.description: Optional qualifier words, lowercase kebab-case ASCII, written after the function.

scope.description: The scope's LONG form (a FIRM, GLOBAL or MASTER row of scopes.json); the name carries its SHORT form. null is a shared resource and carries no scope.

system.description: A systems.json key, or the reserved opal (NAMING_SCHEMA.json resource.grammar slot 1).

archive.description: S12, optional: an existing bucket the object archives to. prefixes are lib/opal_naming.py address() key prefixes ending in /*. kms_key_id adds a KMS grant to the execution role.

dedup_days.description: How long an event's processed-marker row lives (it is what makes a redelivered event a no-op).

extra_statements.description: Further IAM statements for the execution policy (S07), as objects jsonencode() accepts.

function.description: name() slot 3: the function words, lowercase kebab-case. Must match the REGISTER.json row.

handler.description: S04: the object handler, fed one mailbox event at a time per object.

ingress.description: S13-S16, optional: the adapter that turns outside events into mailbox events. clock is a NAMING_SCHEMA cadence (1min, 5min, hourly, daily); topic adds an SNS topic whose messages invoke it.

ldo_id.description: The LDO's number from REGISTER.json, LDO-NNN. Every resource carries it in its LDO tag.

mailbox.description: S01/S02 tuning. batch_size 1 keeps one event per invocation; max_concurrency caps parallel objects (>= 2 when set).

package.description: The Lambda zip both the handler and the ingress run from. source_code_hash defaults to filebase64sha256(filename).

register_file.description: The register the ldo_id is checked against. Only the module's own tests point elsewhere.

scope.description: name() slot 2: the scope's LONG form (a FIRM, GLOBAL or MASTER row). Must match the REGISTER.json row.

secret_arns.description: Secrets Manager ARNs (or ARN globs) the handler and ingress may read.

system.description: lib/opal_naming.py name() slot 1: a systems.json key. Must match the REGISTER.json row.

tags.description: Extra tags; the LDO tags are added on top and win.

chat_assist_mail_bearer_secret_arn.description: The mail route's bearer secret (name or ARN), handed over by NFRA_OPLGTW release r29. Empty = the mail poller is inert.

chat_assist_sms_origination_arn.description: The toll-free number the assistant texts from and listens on (the identity portal-auth's sms_origination_identity_arn names).

dell_agent_user_names.description: IAM user NAMES of the two Dell agent users, which may DECRYPT transcript objects and nothing else under the key (Andrew-direct 2026-10-07: the Dell boxes can read). The default is lib/opal_naming.py name('cloudops', None, 'dell1-agent'|'dell2-agent', 'user') output, the names nfra-ctlpln-identity builds.

reader_principal_arns.description: IAM principals allowed to encrypt and decrypt transcript objects. Andrew's word names two ACCOUNTS (Microsoft identities); each must be mapped to an AWS principal before it is added here.
